detail.longDescription:
PythonForge runs real CPython 3.14 on device. Write, run and debug Python — and let the built-in agent write, run and fix code for you. No server, no account, no analytics.

■ AN AGENT THAT FIXES ITS OWN CODE
Describe what you want. The agent plans, writes, runs, reads the errors and keeps fixing until it works — inside the IDE, on your device. You see every file it touches and every command it runs, and can stop or take over at any moment. Bring your own API key, or point it at a local model such as Ollama.

■ REAL PYTHON, ON DEVICE
Full CPython 3.14 and its standard library run locally: native speed, real files in your own folder, console input, and scripts that keep running while you switch apps. numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, OpenCV, scikit-learn, Pillow, sympy, pyarrow, MLX, Flask and 70+ packages install offline on first launch — anything else installs from PyPI by name.

■ EDITOR AND DEBUGGER
Semantic completion for modules and members, bracket matching, snippets, find and replace, unlimited undo, themes, and a keyboard bar tuned for Python. Breakpoints in the gutter, step over / in / out, variables in the debug panel, and tracebacks you can tap to jump to the failing line.

■ GIT, BUILT IN
Clone, stage, commit, pull and push, with a per-file diff before every commit, plus branches, history and remotes. A bad edit is never final.

■ SSH TERMINAL
Save your servers and open a remote shell from the app — password or private key (ed25519 and RSA). Credentials stay in the Keychain, and Ctrl-C works the way you expect in a real shell.

■ NOTEBOOKS, SQL AND WEB PREVIEW
Run Jupyter notebooks cell by cell. Query SQLite from a built-in console. Preview HTML, CSS and JavaScript in an embedded browser, with three.js, Phaser and PixiJS included.

■ AUTOMATION
Schedule scripts, get a notification when they finish, and launch them from the share sheet or the Home Screen widget.

■ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your scripts, packages, databases and API keys stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded to us, because there is nothing to collect.

Runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 16 or later.
